tei:div.tei:p: 351) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: gu ru'i sgrub pa byin rlabs bum bzang bzhugs: 351) na mo padma kā ra ye: o rgyan rdo rje 'chang la 'dud: gsang sngags lam zhugs rnal 'byor pas: dkyil 'khor kun 'dus spyi dpal rje: rig 'dzin bla ma bsgrub pa'i thabs: byin rlabs bum bzang 'di ru bstan: skal ldan bu yis nyams su longs: sa ma ya: dang po sbyor ba sngon 'gro la: skyabs su 'gro dang sems bskyed ni: na mo: rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag: rig 'dzin bla mar skyabs su mchi: 'gro rnams sangs rgyas la 'god phyir: smon 'jug don dam byang sems bskyed: lan gsum brjod: de nas bgegs srung ni: hūm̐ḥ ma rig gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i bgegs: chos dbyings ngang du mtshams bcad do: ye shes sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i 353)rtsal: gzhom bral rdo rje'i gur khang 'khrigs: u tsa ta ya phaṭa: badzra rakṣa bhrum̐ḥ de nas byin dbab mchod rdzas brlab pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang snang don gyi 'og min gnas: lhun grub dag pa'i zhing khams nas: rig 'dzin padma thod phreng rtsal: brgyud gsum bla ma'i tshogs dang bcas: gnas 'dir dbang byin dngos grub stsol: sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du rlobs: snang srid mchod pa'i phyag rgya che: zag med ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur: sarba dzñā na ā be sha ya pheṃ: ma hā pū dza hoḥ gnyis pa dngos gzhi lha bskyed ni: āḥ chos rnams rang bzhin stong pa che: 354)stong nyid gdangs las thugs rje'i rtsal: rig pa rgyu yi sa bon hūm̐: de las bhrūm̐ 'phros yongs gyur las: bde chen dag pa'i zhing khams su: rang byung lhun grub gzhal yas khang: bkod pa rab rdzogs pho brang dbus: thabs shes pad nyi zla gdan steng: rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su: rig pa chos nyid don gyi lha: mtsho skyed rdo rje sprul pa'i sku: dkar dmar mdangs ldan zhi zhing 'dzum: zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa yis: rdo rje rtse lnga thugs kar 'dzin:

g.yon pas mnyam dag tshe'i bhandha: tshe bcud bdud rtsis bkang ba bsnams: zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol stabs bzhugs: dbu la 'dab ldan mthong grol gsol: sku la phod ka ber mthing dang: mthang sham chos dgos bla gos bklubs: log rtog 'dul phyir thod phreng dang: zhabs la swag lh+wam mdzes par gsol: spyan gnyis 'bru tshugs dbyings su gzigs: gsang yum kha ṭwāṃ mchan du brten: rin po che yis snyan mgul brgyan: ye shes 'ja' 'od 'khyil ba'i klong: snang la rang bzhin med par gsal: spyi bor rigs kyi bdag po ni: rgyal ba 'od snang mtha' yas dmar: mnyam 355)bzhag skyil krung mtshan dpe rdzogs: rigs kun yongs 'dus ngo bor bzhugs: shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro dkar: lho ru rin chen mkha' 'gro ser: nub ru padma mkha' 'gro dmar: byang du karma mkha' 'gro ljang: kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: g.yas pas cang te'u snyan thad dkrol: g.yon pas gri gug dku la brten: dar dpyangs rin chen rus rgyan spras: bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis pad zlar bzhugs: 'khor du 'bum phrag mkha' 'gros bskor: ye shes 'ja' 'od klong du bsgom: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las: 'od 'phros dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba rnams: rig 'dzin bla ma'i rnam par ru: spyan drangs gnyis med ro gcig gyur: de nas spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ bde chen padma 'od kyi zhing: lhun grub dag pa'i gnas yas nas: rig 'dzin padma thod phreng rtsal: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub phyir: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: yongs grub gdan gsum dkyil 'khor 'dir: mi g.yo brtan par bzhugs su gsol: badzra sa ma ya dza dza st+wam̐: tiṣṭha lhan: na mo na ma hoḥ de nas mchod pa ni: 356)oṃ āḥhūm̐: ka dag gdangs las shar ba yi: snang srid mchod pa'i phyag rgyar sprul: rig 'dzin dkyil 'khor dgyes pa'i rdzas: mchod sprin rab 'byams zhing kun khyab:

ye shes bdud rtsi bla na med: dgyes bzhes mchog gi dngos grub stsol: oṃ badzra arghaṃsogs: shapda rū pa sogs: sparshe ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ba liṃ ta rakta sarba ta na ga ṇa pū dza la khā hi: de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐: sku ni mi 'gyur kun tu bzang po'i sku: gsung dbyangs 'gags med mnyam nyid rig pa'i gsung: thugs mchog mi g.yo smra bsam bral ba'i thugs: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thod phreng rtsal la bstod: dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med bde ba'i gar: las bzhi'i phyag rgyar skur bzhengs dga' ster ma: rigs bzhi'i 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya sogs tshang bar brjod: de nas 'dzab dmigs ni: hūm̐: rang nyid rigs 'dus bla ma yi: thugs kar dwangs ma'i 'od thig klong: gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i: lte bar nyi zla'i gwa'u'i sbubs: thugs srog hūm̐ yig dkar dmar la: rtsa ba'i sngags kyis g.yas su bskor: de las 'od 357)'phros rgyal kun mchod: dbang byin dngos grub ma lus bsdus: srog gi snying por ro gcig bstims: mar 'phros 'gro ba'i las nyon sbyangs: 'byung lnga'i dwangs bcud tshe bsod nams: 'od kyi rnam par rang la bsdus: snang grags rig pa chos nyid ngang: ma yengs mi bsgom gzer gyis ni: dkyil 'khor gsum ldan ngang nas bzla: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal hrīḥm ha ri ni sa sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: de ltar mi tshig ma 'dres par: srog sdom gzer bzhi'i gnad ldan pas: bye ba gcig bzlas bsnyen pa dang: sgrub dang las sbyor dmigs pas dbye: dmigs pa'i bsgyur kha gnad ldan na: rim gnyis dngos grub mi 'gyang thob: tshe 'dir phyag rgya'i rig 'dzin brnyes: sa ma ya: rjes rim tshogs mchod rim pa ni: rnal 'byor nyams chags sbyang ba'i thabs: bsod nams nang nas tshogs 'khor zab: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro 'du ba dang:

tshogs rdzogs nyams rtogs 'phel ba'i thabs: ga ṇa tsakra'i 'khor lor brtson : bza' bca' la sogs ci 'byor dang: māṃ sa dza gad dpa' bo'i rdzas: bkod legs yid 'ong legs bshams nas: dang po byin gyis rlab pa ni: hūm̐: snang ba snod kyi ka pā lar: srid pa'i dpal yon tshogs su bshams: kun bzang mchod sprin bla na med: rgyal kun dgyes pa'i 358)rdzas su gyur: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis brlabs: de nas spyan 'dren tshogs 'bul ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang snang dag pa dpal ri'i zhing: bde chen 'gyur med gzhal yas nas: rig 'dzin padma thod phreng rtsal: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma dang: rgya bod paṇa grub rgya mtsho'i tshogs: gnas gsum mkha' 'gro dam can bcas: 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs: dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i tshogs mchod 'bul: bdag cag tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir bzhes: ma hā sarba ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: de nas bskang bshags ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos nyid sgyu 'phrul rol pa las: snod bcud 'dod yon phyi yi tshogs: 'byor tshogs longs spyod nang gi tshogs: bde stong mnyam sbyor gsang ba'i tshogs: lhun grub rang byung mchod pa'i rdzas: ye shes bdud rtsi bla na med: dgongs brda snyan brgyud bla ma dang: yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drug lha: gnas yul dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang: dkyil 'khor gtso mchog thod phreng rtsal: rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro dam can sogs: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: thugs dam bskang la nyams chags 359)bshags: lta ba mtha' bral klong du bskang: sgom pa zang thal chen por bskang: spyod pa blang dor bral bar bskang: 'bras bu ye grol chen por bskang: gnyis snang chos nyid klong du bskang: 'khor ba myang 'das chen por bskang: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: sdom gsum bsrung mtshams las 'das pa:

'dod yon longs spyod tshogs kyis bshags: mi sgrib tshangs par mdzad du gsol: oṃ sa ma ya: āḥs ma ya: hūm̐ sa ma ya: ga ṇa tsakra satwa sa ma ya=sogs: āḥ de nas bsgral bstab ni: hrīḥ ma rig bdag rtog rū tra bgegs: ye shes rol pa'i mtshon gyis bsgral: dkyil 'khor lha yi zhal du bstabs: 'khrul med ka dag dbyings su sangs: ru tra mā ra ya phaṭa: kha raṃ khā hi: de nas tshogs la rol dang lhag ma ni: hoḥ bla med gsang ba'i dam tshig rdzas: tshims pa drug ldan ngang du rol: a la la hoḥ pheṃ: dpal gyi bka' nyan lhag sdud rnams: 'dod yon tshogs kyi lhag ma bzhes: phrin las sgrubs shig sa ma ya: ma bhyo dza sarba ba liṃ ta khā 360)hi: de nas chad mdo bstan skyong ni: hūm̐ bhyoḥ dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyan snga ru: khas blangs dam bcas dregs pa'i sde: chos skyong pho rgyud mo rgyud dang: brtan ma ya ma skyong ma'i tshogs: 'dir gshegs mthun pa'i mchod gter bzhes: zab gsang bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyongs: rab 'byams phrin las yongs 'grub mdzod: dam la ma 'da' sa ma ya: de nas bro mnan ni: hūm̐: ma rig dug gsum 'khrul pa'i 'dre: ye shes rol pa'i phyag rgyas bkug: sku gsum ri rab 'bar bas mnan: nam yang ldang med bro rgyas btab: st+waṃ bha ya nan: mchod bstod bya zhing dngos grub ni: hoḥ rig 'dzin bla ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi: gsang gsum rdo rje'i klong mdzod nas: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang dngos grub: bdag gi sgo gsum snod du bskyil: bum gsang shes rab bzhi pa'i dbang: 'pho smin grol thob dngos grub stsol: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya wākka tsitta sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: de nas bshags pa ni: hoḥ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs spyan snga ru: 'byor tshogs yo byad chung ba dang: sgo gsum bag med 'khrul dbang gis: lha sngags ting 'dzin g.yel ba 361)bshags: badzra sa ma ya shuddhe āḥ oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya sogs: āḥ de nas bsdu ldang bsngo smon ni:

hoḥ thabs kyis bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: chos nyid spros bral dbyings su āḥ rjes thob sgyu ma'i lha ru shar: badzra kā wā tsi hūm̐: dge tshogs 'gro ba yongs la bsngo: kun kyang gdod ma'i sa thob shog: de nas bkra shis ni: hūm̐: rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i byin rlabs dang: sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i bden stobs kyis: bdag cag sgrub mchog 'khor bcas la: dpal yon phun tshogs bkra shis shog: de ltar tshul bzhin nyams blangs na: bskyed rdzogs rnam grangs mang mi dgos: 'di nyid gcig sdus dngos grub thob: tshe 'dir rkyen zhi bsam pa 'grub: phyi ma bde chen padma 'od: rang snang dag pa'i zhing khams su: grol 'gyur the tshom med par nges: bka' srung dregs pa rnam gsum gyis: thub par srungs shig sa ma ya: skal ldan bu dang 'phrad par shog: log lta can la 'di ma 'phrad: bka' 'di'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyongs: nyams pa'i sha khrag srog dbugs rol: gsang ba sku gsung thugs kyi rgya: sa ma ya: brda thim: : ces pa 'di yang gu ru yab yum la snying nas mos pa thob dad dam dpal gyis phyug pa gsang chen gdams pa'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa rnams 362)kyi skal ba dang ldan pa gang des lha reg srid du ring ba dang dri ldan bdug spos mngar gsum gyi zas sna reg bya bzang gos bcas nan cher bskul ngor/ dbyi shod gdan pa chen po'i nye char spom gnas rdo rje rdzong gi yang dben o rgyan gsang phug gi dben phrod nas dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda ris las su kha badzra gyis nyams chos yig ris su bris pa'o// bkra shis//
